Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Casual Plaid Rug, 2' 6" x 8', Flatweave, Light Gray, Beige
Colors: Light Gray, Beige
Materials: stone
If you ever wanted to try something classy for your room, a transitional plaid rug in light grey and beige could make a fresh statement. Made from environmentally sensitive PET, it offers durability as well as stylish design. 2' 6" x 8' Low pile is easy to maintain. Pair with rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
